input_sets.H2: 10 base channels + hydro regime cols 0:4 (14 total); no StreamCat
input_sets.H2E: 10 base channels + full 13-col regime raw (23 total); no encoder
input_sets.H2X: 10 base + hydro 0:4 (14) with cols 4:13 through the env encoder (emb 32)
input_sets.H2X_nomsg: identical to H2X inputs; edge messages zeroed (no-message control)

nomination_rule: On gate tie, the primary treatment H2X is nominated.

estimands.e2a: strict future forecasting without post-cutoff DOC context
estimands.e2b: future reconstruction with a running network (20% post-cutoff context cells visible)
estimands.e3: spatial extrapolation to held-out stations in the largest component
estimands.no_equivalence_boundary: e2a and e2b are separate estimands and must never be pooled or treated as interchangeable evidence

gates.primary: H2X beats the best no-graph model by >=10% MAE reduction in at least 2 of {E2a, E2b, E3} (union of scenario-family passages)

no_harm_margins.e1_global: H2X must not be worse than the best baseline by more than 5% on E1

gates.direction_consistency: gain direction consistent in >=3 of 5 training seeds
gates.dominance_preference: prefer H2X >= H2E >= H2X_nomsg on the primary endpoint; a violation downgrades the reading to 'encoder/topology not necessary' and is never reported as a positive topology claim
gates.high_doc_reporting: top 5%/10% precision, recall and tail error reported separately per scenario family
gates.pilot_reconciliation: the discarded Phase-2B pilot criterion (15% and two-of-three) is recorded as non-operative; operative gates are the endpoints-v1 >=10% union rule plus the per-scenario no-harm margins above

seed_set_note: 2C uses 5 seeds (42-46); 2B pilot used 3 seeds (42-44). Non-inferential margins above are preference/margin rules, not claim-adjacent significance statements.
